## Description

Self check-in on tablet/QR (confirm details and consent), dedicated clinic email inbox with auto-matching and "needs filing" queue, offline read of today's charts and draft notes with encrypted local storage and sync.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Designs approved before build.
- [ ] **AC2.** Offline data is encrypted, time-limited and wiped on sign-out; conflicts on sync are surfaced.
- [ ] **AC3.** Inbound letters are matched with the same identity-match rules as results.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
